clusters.reason: Around Bea's birth in March 1995, within the following year: your mother worn out and on edge with the baby by August, your parents growing distant by November, you with stomach aches and missing school by February 1996, your brother Jonah shouting matches with your father by May, and your mother leaving her job by September. Each shift moves through the household in these months, and no one outside the immediate family's shifts show then.
